verdict.rationale: Sumsub is a SaaS identity-verification platform with Web and Mobile SDKs, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no such setting or control. The WebSDK event messages (sumsub-docs-28) are integration callbacks, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
